source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Continues the heavenly speaker; leaves the pronoun’s antecedent unresolved.
Retains the woman’s fate and difficult family/support clauses with notes.
Preserves the political use of the woman and failure without inventing motives for her.
Keeps the obscure royal-splendor expression and unusual death description.
Preserves betrayal by table companions and military losses.
Retains Kittim and both covenant references without replacing them with historical identifications.
Leaves desire of women open rather than identifying a deity or sexual preference.
Preserves difficult recognition and payment clauses with their uncertainty noted.
Keeps the named opponents and unspecified pronouns without forcing all identities.
Preserves plural seas, the mountain, and unassisted ending.
